subject: Member benefit: automatic 10% back on Google Store, just for being a Google One member
snippet:
Get rewarded for shopping on the Google Store
 
 As a Google One member on a 2 TB plan, you now automatically earn 10% back  
 in store credit on all devices and accessories purchased on the Google  
 Store1. No codes, no points
